test_parse_yaml: test that a Training config object parses YAML with timeout_hours, episodes, benchmarks, and validation fields
test_training_config_creation: test creating a Training instance from an OmegaConf YAML string with benchmark URIs and validation settings
test_training_timeout_hours: test that the Training config correctly stores the timeout_hours value from parsed YAML
test_training_benchmarks_config: test that the Training config parses benchmark URIs and dataset references from YAML input
test_training_validation_config: test that the Training config parses validation benchmark settings from YAML input
